PHASE.NAME: RTK Cloud And VCS Adapter Parity
PHASE.GOAL: Port or wrap RTK cloud, container, VCS hosting, and data-client adapters with compact outputs and route-aware verification.

STEPS.step-1: Add command-specific behavior for gh, glab, git diff/show/log, aws, curl, wget, psql, and container-oriented commands where RTK has stronger compact renderers.
STEPS.step-2: Ensure cloud-data, vcs-hosting, and container families route consistently from raw shell and rewrite hooks.
STEPS.step-3: Strengthen inline tests around command outputs used by the cloud/VCS adapters.
